name: ambiguous_stale_conflict
description: Conflicting and stale decisions in one project. The generator surfaces all of them as claims; there is no detector for staleness or contradiction, so the harness reports that as a known limitation, not a hard failure.

messages.body: Decided to standardize on Postgres for the service datastore.
Update: we are switching the datastore from Postgres to DynamoDB.
Earlier plan: evaluate Cassandra for the datastore (now stale).
